settings.heading: Performance looks better here.
settings.lead: Customer videos, filmed on their own cars. Hover or tap to play.

settings.question: How does the cap stay level?
settings.answer: A sealed bearing lets the face turn free of the wheel. A counterweight under the emblem keeps it upright, so the logo reads level at any speed.

settings.question: Will it fit my car?
settings.answer: Mercedes, BMW and MG fit at launch. Pick your model and we send the matching size. Not listed? Send us your car on WhatsApp and we make it in about a day.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: Cash on delivery. Open the box, check the set, then pay the courier.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t fit?
settings.answer: We swap it. Message us on WhatsApp with a photo and we arrange the exchange.

settings.question: What if a cap falls off?
settings.answer: We replace it. That is the warranty, in one line.

settings.question: Can I send it as a gift?
settings.answer: Yes. Add the gift box at checkout and include a note for the card.

settings.question: What file do I need for Custom?
settings.answer: A PNG or SVG with clear edges works best. We send a proof on WhatsApp before we make your set.

settings.question: How long is delivery?
settings.answer: Delivery times by city show at checkout. Custom and on-request sets add about a day.
